name: On Any Journey
storyline: Kai, Mateo, and Summer grew up in an ordinary town. They felt the weight of their differences, which made them feel shy and inferior. In a bid to fit in, they made a wish and embarked on a challenging adventure, hoping to make their wishes come true.
summary:
On Any Journey is an immersive adventure built for two players, demanding tight cooperation and teamwork. With a striking blend of visual styles and inventive co-op puzzle-solving, this game isn’t just about exploring a world—it’s about experiencing a heartfelt story of friendship and self-discovery.

On Any Journey is all about the thrill of shared adventure. As Kai, Mateo, and Summer, you’ll embark on an unforgettable quest, encountering the enigmatic magician Bruno, the mysterious, mask-wearing Puka clan, and even a giant rockstar who rules the ocean depths. But no great story is complete without a formidable villain—enter "Big Man" and his relentless guards, standing in your way.

Throughout your journey, you’ll face tough choices and thrilling challenges. Confidence will battle self-doubt. Destiny will test your resolve. And when the day comes to an end, will you hold onto who you truly are, or surrender to the fate that seeks to define you?
